ground_truth_witness: Let f(τ)=η(3τ)^2η(9τ)^2=q−2q^4−q^7+O(q^8), the normalized weight-2 level-27 newform. Let χ(n)=(n/5), and let f′=f⊗χ (a normalized quadratic-twist newform). For n=1,…,7, a_n(f)=(1,0,0,−2,0,0,−1) and χ(n)=(1,−1,−1,1,0,1,−1). Thus a_n(f′)=χ(n)a_n(f)=(1,0,0,−2,0,0,1).
ground_truth_flaw: If X is the largest integer for which the coefficients of a normalized newform f and its quadratic twist f′ agree for every n≤X, then χ(n) is nonnegative for every n≤X.
